ranked.headline: Generative and language models decompose single-cell and spatial omics data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and journal papers extend deep generative and LLM approaches to annotation, spatial inference, and perturbation analysis in omics.

ranked.headline: Diffusion and transformer generators for molecules and proteins add realism checks
ranked.summary: Benchmarks against confirmed actives and synthesis-aware scoring now test whether generated designs are realistic, not merely produced.

ranked.headline: Network models infer regulatory structure and integrate multi-omics features
ranked.summary: Multi-omics and single-cell datasets now support network models that encode cross-feature and cross-modal dependencies for regulatory inference.

ranked.headline: Learned models fuse histology, multi-omics and cfDNA features to predict tumor traits
ranked.summary: Integrative models now couple histology, cfDNA fragmentation and spatial profiles with outcomes, extending learned integration beyond bulk omics.

ranked.headline: Protein language model embeddings power diverse function and interaction predictors
ranked.summary: Recent work reuses pretrained protein language model embeddings as inputs to task-specific predictors for function, binding, and peptide tasks.

ranked.headline: Multimodal deep learning fuses sequence, structure and text for bioactivity prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and journal articles extend transfer learning, zero-shot design and multimodal fusion to dissociation rates, synergy and permeability.

ranked.headline: Learned representations predict nucleic acid functional sites across diverse targets
ranked.summary: Sparse autoencoders and foundation models are now used to interpret, audit and steer nucleic acid predictors, not only to score them.

ranked.headline: Reproducible software now spans raw-read QC, taxonomy, and pathogen detection
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair sequence-analysis methods with packaged workflows, desktop tools, and web interfaces for routine use.

ranked.headline: Deep networks predict regulatory states from sequence, methylation and genotype context
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications extend sequence-based regulatory models to chromatin structure, personalized diploid genomes, and long-read mosaic calling.

ranked.headline: Reproducible software for single-cell, methylation, and microbiome omics analysis
ranked.summary: Recent releases pair reproducibility features such as containers, Snakemake pipelines, and Shiny interfaces with interactive exploration of omics data.

ranked.headline: Learned models assign raw nanopore and sequencing measurements to discrete sources
ranked.summary: Recent work applies deep learning directly to raw nanopore current traces to label protein capture phases and demultiplex barcodes.

ranked.headline: Statistical tests of expression change along single-cell pseudotime
ranked.summary: Pseudotime-resolved differential testing now extends to co-expression, splicing, and TWAS at cell-state resolution, with calibrated and scalable inference.

ranked.headline: Generative language models designing antibodies, TCRs, neoantigens, and mRNA
ranked.summary: Recent work applies transformers and language models to antigen-directed sequence design spanning antibodies, TCRs, neoantigens, and mRNA.

ranked.headline: Inferring cell type-specific splicing and enhancer regulation from functional readouts
ranked.summary: Functional readouts from MPRA, knockdown and single-cell multiome data now support interpretable and generative models of regulatory activity.

ranked.headline: Inferring cell fate and niche trajectories from sequential spatial transcriptomic slides
ranked.summary: Sequential spatial transcriptomics across developmental time points now supports explicit temporal modeling of spatial domains and microenvironments.

ranked.headline: Post-GWAS inference is adapted to relatedness, pathway specificity and gene ranking
ranked.summary: Recent items extend fine-mapping, marker p-values, and gene prioritization to related samples and specific genetic pathways.

ranked.headline: Network-based ML prioritizes repurposing candidates and predicts drug safety endpoints
ranked.summary: Multimodal and network-level data now yield repurposing nominations, while new benchmarks expose performance sensitivity to distribution shifts across methods.

ranked.headline: Computational biomolecular methods judged against experimental and reference data
ranked.summary: Blind and large-scale benchmarks now test structure, nucleotide model and kinetics methods against experimental or independent reference data.

ranked.headline: Transformers and LLMs predict disease risk and impute or decode biomedical data
ranked.summary: Transformer models now target EHR, proteomics, metabolomics, and nucleotide data, adding biological context and zero-shot transfer to prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Structure-aware models predict complex binding while benchmarks expose scorer bias
ranked.summary: Structure-aware predictors for molecular complexes are advancing while independent benchmarks reveal affinity and ΔΔG scorer limitations.

ranked.headline: Self-supervised networks learn representations of transcriptomic and tissue imaging data
ranked.summary: November 2025 work extends label-free self-supervised learning across spatial transcriptomics, multiplexed imaging, cardiac MR, and brain graphs.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and ML tools map viral host range from phage genomes and metagenomes
ranked.summary: Context-dependent phage-host prediction performance and scalable viral taxonomy tools arrive as viral genome catalogs grow to hundreds of thousands of entries.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking and new callers for structural, copy number and de novo variants
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks and tools assess variant calling accuracy across long-read, shallow, trio and twin WGS designs, alongside T2T-CHM13 reference effects.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking nanopore and single-cell sequencing methods for noisy measurements
ranked.summary: Recent preprints quantify how basecalling versions and single-cell amplification strategies affect detection on sparse or indirect sequencing readouts.

ranked.headline: Methylation diversity shifts with temperature and long-read epiallele profiling
ranked.summary: Long-read and graph-based tools now resolve methylation diversity across populations, organelles, and pangenomes.

ranked.headline: Computational screening and generative design of bioactive small molecules and peptides
ranked.summary: Late-2025 studies pair ultra-large docking, deep QSAR and bivalent generative models with experimental testing of designed or prioritized compounds.

ranked.headline: MD simulations map allosteric pathways in RNA recognition and RNA-protein binding
ranked.summary: Molecular dynamics and data-driven models now resolve how sequence and protein binding tune allosteric communication in RNA and RNA-protein complexes.

ranked.headline: Consistent phylogenetic methods now target gene tree error, network structure, and…
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a Nature paper advance consistent tree and network inference and confidence assessment for very large phylogenies.

ranked.headline: Genome-wide profiling maps plasmid, phage and transposon exchange across bacteria
ranked.summary: Population-scale genomic surveys now resolve plasmid, phage, and transposon exchange and benchmark tools for their detection in short-read data.

ranked.headline: Tools mine literature and transcriptomes to build interpretable functional networks
ranked.summary: Public literature, transcriptomic archives, and ontology mappings are being converted into deployable tools for network-level biological interpretation.

ranked.headline: Computational handling of PTMs and chemical modifications in MS-based proteomics
ranked.summary: Deep learning and combinatorial spectral methods now explicitly encode modification chemistry and coexisting PTM states in MS proteomics prediction.

ranked.headline: Simulations link resistance development and dosing to antibiotic treatment outcomes
ranked.summary: Simulations now quantify how resistance development, dosing schedules, and resource supply shape microbial persistence and treatment outcomes.

ranked.headline: Learned models span crystal imaging, genome annotation, and AlphaFold domain parsing
ranked.summary: Learned models and post-processing of predicted structures are now applied to experimental images, genomes, and variant effect prediction.

ranked.headline: Accessible software delivers spatial, metabolic, breeding, and tweezers analysis tools
ranked.summary: Recent tools package spatial modeling, metabolic, breeding, and magnetic tweezers workflows as open, runnable software.

ranked.headline: Connectivity and surface geometry as constraints in brain imaging models
ranked.summary: Multi-site and PET datasets are heterogeneous, so preprocessing and modeling tools must encode geometry, connectivity, or harmonization explicitly.

ranked.headline: Modeling neural variability and EEG decoding with Bayesian and data-driven methods
ranked.summary: Recent methods separate structured neural effects from noise across M/EEG, BCI, and single-neuron recordings, improving decoding and variability analysis.

ranked.headline: Computational design and frustration analysis of antibody-spike interfaces
ranked.summary: RFdiffusion now designs atomically accurate antibodies, while AI-plus-MD pipelines stabilize scaffolds and map spike-antibody energetics.

ranked.headline: Computational methods refine interpretation of structural and sequence variants
ranked.summary: Complex de novo structural variants and mitochondrial exome variants are now being resolved with latent-space and structure-aware classifiers.

ranked.headline: Computational inference of microbial enzyme and metabolic function across genomes
ranked.summary: Genome-scale models and ecosystem-scale enzyme censuses now let computation resolve microbial metabolic function at strain and community levels.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools turn omics profiles into network and functional interpretations
ranked.summary: Web-accessible pipelines now connect raw lipidomics, cytokine array, and multi-omics data to biological interpretation.
